# Command reference

<!-- Generated by tools/gen_docs.py -- do not edit by hand. Run `./docsis docs` to regenerate. -->

Two command sets: the `docsis` program that runs and inspects a lab, and the CMTS-style shell you get inside `docsis cli`.

## `docsis`

| Subcommand | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `up` | run the lab |
| `run` | run headless until online, then report |
| `cli` | attach a CMTS-style shell |
| `dash` | attach the live dashboard |
| `cfg` | DOCSIS configuration file tool |
| `pcap` | summarise a capture through tshark |
| `scenarios` | list the built-in scenarios |
| `docs` | regenerate the reference documentation |
| `doctor` | check the environment and self-test |

### `docsis up`

Run the lab.

```
docsis up [-h] [--scenario SCENARIO] [--capture CAPTURE] [--no-capture]
                 [--quiet] [--log-level {debug,info,notice,warn,error}]
                 [--mute MUTE] [--speed SPEED] [--duration DURATION]
                 [--socket SOCKET] [--no-comments] [--upstreams {1,2}]
                 [--modems MODEMS] [--distance DISTANCE] [--us-loss US_LOSS]
                 [--ds-loss DS_LOSS] [--cpe {sim,utun,none}] [--cpe-ip CPE_IP]
```

| Option | Meaning | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--scenario` | which situation to run (see 'docsis scenarios') |  | `default` |
| `--capture` | pcapng output path |  | `captures/docsis.pcapng` |
| `--no-capture` |  |  |  |
| `--quiet` | do not echo the event log to stdout |  |  |
| `--log-level` |  | `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warn`, `error` | `info` |
| `--mute` | comma-separated log categories to suppress (default: map,sync -- the per-MAP chatter) |  | `map,sync` |
| `--speed` | time scale; 1.0 is real time, 0 runs as fast as possible |  | `1.0` |
| `--duration` | stop after this many simulated seconds |  |  |
| `--socket` |  |  | `.docsislab.sock` |
| `--no-comments` | omit the explanatory pcapng packet comments |  |  |
| `--upstreams` |  | `1`, `2` | `1` |
| `--modems` |  |  |  |
| `--distance` | override every modem's distance from the CMTS, km |  |  |
| `--us-loss` | upstream burst loss, percent |  |  |
| `--ds-loss` |  |  |  |
| `--cpe` | sim: a simulated host (no privileges). utun: a real macOS interface, needs sudo | `sim`, `utun`, `none` | `sim` |
| `--cpe-ip` |  |  | `10.20.0.10` |

### `docsis run`

Run headless until online, then report.

```
docsis run [-h] [--scenario SCENARIO] [--capture CAPTURE]
                  [--no-capture] [--quiet]
                  [--log-level {debug,info,notice,warn,error}] [--mute MUTE]
                  [--timeout TIMEOUT] [--settle SETTLE]
```

| Option | Meaning | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--scenario` | which situation to run (see 'docsis scenarios') |  | `default` |
| `--capture` | pcapng output path |  | `captures/docsis.pcapng` |
| `--no-capture` |  |  |  |
| `--quiet` | do not echo the event log to stdout |  |  |
| `--log-level` |  | `debug`, `info`, `notice`, `warn`, `error` | `info` |
| `--mute` | comma-separated log categories to suppress (default: map,sync -- the per-MAP chatter) |  | `map,sync` |
| `--timeout` |  |  | `30.0` |
| `--settle` | keep running this long after everything is online |  |  |

### `docsis cli`

Attach a CMTS-style shell.

```
docsis cli [-h] [--socket SOCKET] [command ...]
```

| Option | Meaning | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--socket` |  |  | `.docsislab.sock` |
| `<command>` | run one command and exit |  |  |

### `docsis dash`

Attach the live dashboard.

```
docsis dash [-h] [--socket SOCKET] [--interval INTERVAL]
```

| Option | Meaning | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--socket` |  |  | `.docsislab.sock` |
| `--interval` |  |  | `0.25` |

### `docsis cfg`

DOCSIS configuration file tool.

```
docsis cfg [-h] [--out OUT] [--secret SECRET] [--rate RATE]
                  {encode,decode,forge} [source]
```

| Option | Meaning | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `<action>` |  | `encode`, `decode`, `forge` |  |
| `<source>` | JSON spec (encode) or binary config file (decode/forge) |  |  |
| `--out` |  |  |  |
| `--secret` |  |  | `docsislab` |
| `--rate` | for 'forge': the upstream rate to substitute |  | `100000000` |

| --- | --- | --- | --- |

### `docsis scenarios`

List the built-in scenarios.

```
docsis scenarios [-h]
```

### `docsis docs`

Regenerate the reference documentation.

```
docsis docs [-h] [--check] [--out OUT]
```

| Option | Meaning | Choices | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--check` | exit non-zero if the docs on disk are stale |  |  |
| `--out` | write somewhere other than docs/ |  |  |

### `docsis doctor`

Check the environment and self-test.

```
docsis doctor [-h]
```

## The CMTS shell

Inside `docsis cli`. Unambiguous abbreviations work, so `sh ca mo` is `show cable modem`. A single command can also be run without attaching an interactive shell:

```sh
./docsis cli show cable modem
```

### Inspecting

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `show version` | software and topology summary |
| `show topology` | what the plant is made of |
| `show cable modem [<mac\|sid\|ip>] [verbose]` | one line per modem, or details for one |
| `show cable modem summary` | count of modems by state |
| `show cable modem phy` | per-modem PHY measurements |
| `show cable modem states` | what each initialisation state means |
| `show cable flap-list` | modems that have lost and regained service |
| `show cable qos service-flow` | admitted service flows |
| `show interface cable [upstream\|downstream [<id>]]` | cable interface counters |
| `show cable modulation-profile [<upstream-id>]` | burst profile per interval usage code |
| `show cable ucd [<upstream-id>]` | upstream channel descriptors |
| `show cable map [<upstream-id>]` | the most recent MAP, decoded |
| `show cable timing` | DOCSIS timebase and mini-slots |
| `show cable scheduler` | upstream scheduler state |
| `show cable dhcp` | provisioning leases and services |
| `show cable config [<filename>]` | decode a configuration file |
| `show cable plant` | HFC plant counters and impairments |
| `show logging [<lines>] [<source>]` | event log tail |
| `show cm [<name>] [verbose]` | cable-modem side view |
| `show cpe` | customer equipment behind the modems |

### Acting

| Command | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `clear cable modem <mac\|sid\|name\|all> reset` | force a modem to re-initialise |
| `test cable noise <milliseconds> [<upstream-id>]` | destroy upstream bursts for a while |
| `test cable loss <us-percent> [<ds-percent>]` | set random upstream/downstream loss |
| `test cable ucc <mac\|sid\|name> <upstream-id>` | move a modem to another upstream |
| `ping <address> [<cpe>] [count <n>]` | ping from a CPE |
| `debug cable mac-messages {on\|off}` | echo the per-MAP and per-SYNC chatter |
